text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since we learned
of Ms.
Kashimoto's past from Director
Akikawa. One
night...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... When will you give up?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... That's... my line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse and Little Cocon are facing
off in a
heated partner running session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After learning about Ms. Kashimoto's
past, Team
Zenith was at a total loss for
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Having a racer injure herself mid-race
like that must've been traumatizing for
Trainer
Kashimoto... I doubt she was able
to take it well...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
No wonder she's so insistent about our
nutritional
intake and making sure we
don't get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith falls quiet, all of them lost
in their
muddled thoughts. After a few
moments of
silence...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm really grateful to Trainer

Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
My skills have improved because of her
and my body's gotten stronger. Looking
at me now, no one would believe I was
just a child three years
ago.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I want to continue working under her
guidance.
You guys feel the same, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite lingering uncertainty, the rest of
Team
Zenith nod firmly at Little Cocon's
question.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The target time Trainer Kashimoto
calculated for
me is 3 minutes 6.2
seconds...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
These three years I've spent chasing
after that
goal have really come to
shape me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
And it's not only the Unity Cup that I've
gotten
great results in, but the Twinkle
Series too.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I've only been able to come so far
thanks to Trainer Kashimoto, and I want
her to continue
teaching me and helping
me grow.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all I want, but... No, that's why...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon raises her head with a
determined
expression.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's why I— why we have to do better than she thinks we can.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: What're you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto set my target time for 3
minutes 6.2 seconds. That's the time I
should
strive to get, and it's meant to be
my final goal.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
But it also means she believes that's my
limit and I
can't run any faster than that.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Ahh, I getcha! So what you're saying is—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We've got to eclipse her expectations
entirely.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
If we can do that, we can tear down the

misguided beliefs she's held on to for so
long!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sparks of passion ignite once more
within the
sullen eyes of each team
member.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you said it. Let's knock her socks
off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They discuss their training plans going
forward,
then call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I didn't think you were the type to
want to
exceed someone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Well, after hearing about her past, I
couldn't just
sit back and do nothing,
could I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon turns her face away with a
huff, but
Bitter Glasse doesn't avert her
gaze.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Little Cocon? Something's been
bothering
me since you said we should
do this all together.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
You could have just disbanded the team
and kept
Ms. Kashimoto all to yourself
as your personal
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a sweeter deal for you. Since you
care so
much about getting stronger, I
thought it'd be a
no-brainer.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: But you stopped yourself from saying "I have to have to do better" to say "we have to do better."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...What's your point?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, just that you surprised me.
You've been
a loner since you entered
Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were like me and found it
a waste
of time to make friends and
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
My way of thinking has changed. That's
all.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse relentlessly keeps up the
pressure to
make her elaborate, and
Little Cocon edges away
in discomfort.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, I was part of a local
running
team.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
One day, one of our teammates brought
a sports
catalogue to practice.

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Look here! We could get matching shoes
for
everyone! These ones are cute!

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice idea! Those red shoes look
super cool!
What do you all think?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was overjoyed at the idea of
getting
matching shoes, but I didn't
understand what the
point of it was.

text_block_list.name: Young Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Count me out.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That one comment was enough to turn
everyone against me. Similar things kept
happening, and
one day my trainer
called me to talk.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Cocon, you're being too stubborn with
your team.
You have to at least try to
get along with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I quit the team. I became the
girl who
didn't know how to be a team
player.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was so against the idea of
this whole
team competition.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Rankings based on team performance?
Having to
play nice with everyone all the
time? It wasn't for
me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
But just as I was about to dismiss the
whole idea,
Trainer Kashimoto called me
in to see her.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
In my team, I will manage everyone's
activities.
You won't need to worry
about anyone apart
from yourself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That's how professional teams work,
after all. Each member carries out their
own role, without
needlessly meddling in
each other's affairs.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I believe a team of similar nature would
suit your
character.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I know she wasn't saying all that for my
sake. I
know that.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
But even so, I was... happy. Glad to find
out that
impersonal teams existed.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
When we began competing together, I
even felt a
sense of responsibility for the
team's success.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Being in this team has been... Well, it's
new
territory for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon shifts her gaze downward.
After a
moment of silence, Bitter Glasse
speaks up.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: It's the same for me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: People always kept their distance from me because they found it freaky how I always get way too into my training.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
So this is like a completely new frontier
for me
too. Heh, guess we're two peas in
a pod!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse's laughter echoes out into
the starry
night sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Cocon and Glasse
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Zenith continues training in line
with the
regimen Ms. Kashimoto
originally crafted for
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And upon finishing their base training,
they
complete an additional three hours
of hard
exercise!

text_block_list.name: Member A
text_block_list.text: This... might be a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Member B
text_block_list.text:
Stop spacin' out! Watch the race and
take
pointers!

text_block_list.name: Cocon and Glasse
text_block_list.text: I'm not losing to youuu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two racers pass the final corner,
accelerate
together on the
homestretch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And speed past the finish line,
shoulder to
shoulder!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I was this close to outpacing you... How annoying!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huff... Whew, haven't felt that fired up in a while!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
But, man, your lung capacity is the real
deal...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did you say something?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nothing at all! Anyway, trying to
outrun each other during pair running is
pretty effective
training! Let's add it to
future sessions too!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"We will all be absent from training until
the next
Unity Cup"...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Not only are they doing a group
boycott, but
they're doing intense solo
training too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The letter shakes in Ms. Kashimoto's
trembling
hands.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No... It's happening again... I'm nothing
but a
failure of a trainer!
